# Vendored copy of map-engine

Source repository: https://github.com/travisduffy/map-engine
Source commit: 835cbde (branch main, package version 0.0.7)

This folder holds the files that `npm pack` produces from that commit after `npm run build`. Do not edit them by hand.

`package.json` has its `scripts`, `devDependencies`, and `workspaces` fields removed. The copy is already built, and the `prepare` script would try to rebuild it from source that this folder does not hold.
